For the data set \( \{4,-19\} \), the sample mean is
\[
\bar{x}=\frac{4+(-19)}{2}=-\frac{15}{2}.
\]
Squared deviations:
\[
\left(4+\frac{15}{2}\right)^2=\left(\frac{23}{2}\right)^2=\frac{529}{4},\qquad
\left(-19+\frac{15}{2}\right)^2=\left(-\frac{23}{2}\right)^2=\frac{529}{4}.
\]
Sum of squared deviations:
\[
\frac{529}{4}+\frac{529}{4}=\frac{529}{2}.
\]
Sample variance (divide by \(n-1=1\)):
\[
s^2=\frac{\frac{529}{2}}{1}=\frac{529}{2}.
\]
So the sample standard deviation is
\[
s=\sqrt{\frac{529}{2}}=\frac{23}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{23\sqrt{2}}{2}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{23\sqrt{2}}{2}}
\]
